title: Construction of normalized projective-line comparison data
statement: Let l be prime and f:X→S a morphism of Noetherian schemes with DiagonalTraceLocalizations at X and S. For a specified isomorphism m:X≅P1(S) over S and l invertible on S, there is a Presentation p over ULift(Q_l) with p.model.model=m. This asserts only the normalized Chern, twisting, restriction, derived-image and limit comparison data, not invertibility of the unit/Chern splitting, trace normalization, or fullness of completed restriction.

source.place: paragraph (1), construction of normalized projective-line comparison data

proof.text: Obtain the partial normalized comparison data from exists_diagonalTraceComparisonPartial, then obtain the two Milnor invertibility assertions from diagonalTraceComparisonLimitIsos. Assemble the full Presentation record field by field; the model equality is inherited from the partial record.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), assembly after separating the geometric/derived data and Milnor invertibility

lean.statement:
theorem exists_diagonalTraceComparisonPresentation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (m : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S)
    (hm : m.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    ∃ p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f, p.model.model = m
